name: Nimbus ANC Headphones
description: Closed-back wireless headphones with hybrid active noise cancelling, 30-hour battery, and a fold-flat travel case. Tuned for speech and long listening sessions, not bass-heavy EDM. USB-C charging, 3.5 mm cable in the box.

name: Harbor Canvas Tote
description: 16 oz waxed canvas tote with a wide base, interior zip pocket, and leather handles that soften with use. Holds a 15-inch laptop in a padded sleeve. Unlined so it dries quickly after rain.

name: Kiln Gooseneck Kettle
description: 700 ml stainless gooseneck kettle for pour-over. Temperature-marked lid, stay-cool handle, and a slow, even pour. Not electric — designed for a gas or induction hob.

name: Daybreak Merino Tee
description: Lightweight 160 gsm merino crewneck. Odor-resistant, temperature-regulating, and cut with a slightly relaxed shoulder. Not a compression shirt. Hand wash or gentle cycle.

name: Field Notes Desk Lamp
description: Articulated brass-and-oak desk lamp with a warm 2700 K LED. Rotary dimmer on the base. USB-C powered, no battery. Shade tilts independently of the arm.

name: Drift Running Socks 3-pack
description: Cushioned crew socks with a blister-guard heel and reinforced toe. Three pairs: slate, sand, and rust. Not compression socks. Machine wash cold.

name: Cedar Travel Wallet
description: Full-grain leather travel wallet with a passport slot, four card sleeves, and a zip coin pocket. Fits EU and US passports. No RFID lining — keep it simple.

name: Lumen USB-C Hub 7-port
description: Aluminum 7-port hub: HDMI 4K60, two USB-A 3.1, two USB-C, SD, and 100 W passthrough. Does not charge a laptop on its own without a power adapter on the passthrough port.

name: Quarry Stone Mug
description: 350 ml speckled stoneware mug, dishwasher safe, slightly irregular rim from the kiln. Not microwave-safe because of the iron speckle. Sold individually.

name: Alpine Packable Rain Shell
description: 2.5-layer waterproof shell that stuffs into its own chest pocket. Fully taped seams, two-way zipper, no insulation. Not windproof enough for alpine winter — it is a rain jacket.

name: Ember French Press 1L
description: Borosilicate French press with a fine mesh filter and a heat-retaining sleeve. Makes four mugs. Not for stovetop use. Replacement filters sold separately.

name: Folio Lined Notebook A5
description: A5 notebook, 96 pages of 90 gsm cream paper, thread-bound so it lies flat. Elastic closure and a ribbon marker. Paper is fountain-pen friendly; not waterproof.
